text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: [AUTO] High-volume outbound to external error tracker detected from staging-forwarder. 1.2k requests in last 10m to sentry.example.com. Sample object: s3://redwood-staging-logs/debug-forwarder/2026-03-18/trace-9c3.json

alex: oncall here — which forwarder / sa? linking logs now.

pagerbot: forwarder_id=fw-9c3, origin=staging-forwarder, service_account=staging-forwarder@redwood-infra. Headers show X-Forwarded-By: debug-forwarder/v2.

sam: i rolled a test change yesterday to enable our dev sentry relay. i thought it only sent app errors, not raw s3 debug blobs. looking at config.

maria: pause egress to sentry.example.com from staging VPC immediately. assume PII exposure until proven otherwise. rotate keys for staging-forwarder SA. @alex @sam start rotation now.

oncall-frontend: blocked outbound to sentry.example.com in staging egress SG (rule id sg-alloc-42). Confirmed flows stopped ~14:12 UTC.

alex: grabbing sample object to inspect. found traces with request_url and user_email fields. treat as sensitive. sample excerpt below:

```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-18T14:08:23Z","request_id":"req_8f3a","user_email":"tester+staging@example.com","path":"/api/v1/purchase","headers":{"authorization":"***REDACTED***"},"stack":"... at handler.js:45"}
```

sam: ok i see it. that definitely contains user-identifiable fields. initiating key revoke for SA. running: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=staging-forwarder@redwood-infra` then delete the active key and create new key. will update forwarder deployment with new creds.

maria: initiate third-party data erasure request to sentry (contact + ticket). legal/privacy looped. @privacy @legal please advise on mandatory customer notification threshold.

privacy: we'll triage — because this is staging, customer-facing prod data likely not impacted, but need inventory of any real-user email/address values. if any production tokens present -> notify customers.

eng-sre: i'll take the post-incident owner and run full artifact scrub and retention check. capturing timeline and actions. handoff to night shift for completion.

sam: rotation steps executed: revoked key id key-73, created new key key-99, updated k8s secret `staging-forwarder-creds`, and restarted deployment `debug-forwarder-v2`. 14:22 UTC. verify logs for resumed forwarder egress.

oncall-frontend: confirm no new outbound connections to sentry.example.com after restart (14:23 UTC). netflow shows 0 connections.

alex: removing offending objects from external tracker: reached out to Sentry admin using our org API key — sent takedown request, ticket #SENTRY-482. also queued S3 objects for purge: `aws s3 rm s3://redwood-staging-logs/debug-forwarder/2026-03-18/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "trace-9c3*"`.

maria: good. start internal incident classification: security/privacy incident -> moderate risk, staging-only, no confirmed prod leakage. assign severity P2.

eng-sre: checklist for follow-up (owning): 1) confirm all forwarder instances use new creds; 2) run grep for patterns/PII across last 7 days in staging; 3) ensure retention policy on forwarder excludes raw request bodies; 4) update runbook and gating to prevent third-party relay for S3 debug objects. I'll log the runbook changes.

sam: i'll keep ownership overnight and will post an update at 03:00 UTC with final scrub status and any additional findings. handoff: sam -> night-oncall.

maria: legal asked for timeline and sample sanitized payload for the internal report. please redact any emails before attaching.

privacy: prepared short internal notice template; will wait for final confirmation of no prod impact before wider distribution.

alex: quick note — if you pulled any objects locally, delete local copies and confirm. i removed my local sample.

eng-sre: confirmed containment actions executed. opening incident ticket INC-2026-042 and assigning notes. closing Slack coordination thread, will update ticket with final findings. :white_check_mark:
